description: Judge a project's glossaries against the words its code uses, or rewrite them.

command.description: Required. The shell command that starts the coinagerie command line, to which the batch command and its project folders are appended.

projectConfigurationPath.description: Required. Where each project keeps its coinagerie configuration, relative to the project's root, such as coinagerie.config.ts. It is never searched for.

write.description: Rewrite each glossary to hold exactly the code's words, keeping definitions, instead of failing when one disagrees.

title: Coinagerie check
